definitions.explanation: Tools and instruments used to prepare and cook food, such as knives, ladles, whisks, spatulas, and peelers. Usually refers to hand tools rather than large appliances.

notes:
A general term for tools used in cooking. Literally ⟦{調理|ちょうり}→調理：07156_chouri⟧ (cooking) + ⟦{用具|ようぐ}→用具：09667_yougu⟧ (tools, implements).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to get a set of cooking utensils
- {調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{洗|あら}う→洗う：00827_arau⟧: to wash cooking utensils
- {調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}⟦{一式|いっしき}→一式：15714_isshiki⟧: a full set of cooking utensils
- ⟦{基本|きほん}→基本：00226_kihon⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}: basic cooking utensils
- ⟦アウトドア→アウトドア：10695_autodoa⟧⟦{用|よう}→〜用：09842_you⟧{調理用具|ちょうりようぐ}: outdoor cooking utensils

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{調理器具|ちょうりきぐ}→調理器具：14991_chourikigu⟧: cooking implements — very close in meaning; may imply slightly larger tools including some small appliances
- ⟦{台所|だいどころ}{用品|ようひん}→台所用品：18141_daidokoroyouhin⟧: kitchen goods — broader, including containers, cleaning items, and consumables
- ⟦キッチン→キッチン：10815_kicchin⟧⟦{用品|ようひん}→用品：13526_youhin⟧: kitchen goods — the more modern version of ⟦{台所|だいどころ}{用品|ようひん}→台所用品：18141_daidokoroyouhin⟧
- {鍋|なべ}{釜|かま}: pots and pans (fixed expression)
